messages:
Maya (product): Quick planning thread — proposing three weekends for the annual planning: Oct 11-12, Oct 18-19, or Oct 25-26. Need to lock venue, facilitation owners, and run a tech dry-run the week before. Who's available and who can own facilitation/runbook/attendee comms?

Liam (eng): Can't do 10/18 (travel). 10/11 works for me. We'll need Conference A (projector + 2 breakout rooms). Ops — can you confirm capacity and AV?

Ashwin (ops): Confirmed Conference A capacity = 80. Projector, wired ethernet, and basic AV included. Guest Wi‑Fi on a separate VLAN; to stream we'll whitelist 3 devices. I can arrange vendor contact (casey@venue.com). Suggest dry‑run Wed 10/9 10:00am PT.

Elaine (design): I can run the PM/Design breakout. I'll prepare two decks: product strategy + research highlights. Decks ready by 10/01. Please add me to the OKR doc.

Jonas (gdpr): Quick flag — any demos with customer data? We need anonymized samples and legal sign‑off. Recommend a 30m compliance sync before the event to lock demo materials.

Maya (product): Good call Jonas. Action items: assign facilitation owners, confirm tech dry‑run, finalize deck owners, legal sign‑off on demos. Who volunteers to own the runbook + attendee comms?

Liam (eng): I'll own the runbook and remote streaming tests. Dry‑run plan (short):
```
10:00 - 10:10 Intro & objectives
10:10 - 10:40 AV test + mic checks
10:40 - 11:20 Deck walkthrough (leads present)
11:20 - 11:40 Failover & backup plan
11:40 - 12:00 Q&A + next steps
```

Ashwin (ops): :thumbsup: Added AV vendor and will whitelist the stream IPs. Jonas — can legal give the anonymization checklist by 10/05?

Jonas (gdpr): Yes, I'll post the checklist in #legal by 10/04. Also recommend disabling screen recording on guest Wi‑Fi during live demos.

offsite-bot: Calendar poll created — https://cal.poll/abcd — please vote by EOD Friday. Tentative dry‑run invite queued for Wed 10/09 10:00am PT.

Maya (product): If poll lands on 10/11 we'll lock travel and send formal invites. Elaine — added you to the OKR doc. Liam — can you upload the runbook template to the shared folder? Link to central drive: https://drive.re/redwood/annual-planning

Liam (eng): Done — uploaded runbook template as runbook-annual-planning-v1.md. I'll share during the dry‑run.

Elaine (design): Deck owners noted. I'll also drop a 1‑pager for the facilitation exercises. Need two volunteers to co‑facilitate the exercise rooms.

Ashwin (ops): I can cover breakout room tech for at least one session. If someone else takes the other facilitation role we're set.

Maya (product): Perfect. I'll post a final checklist tomorrow. For now: @here vote in the poll + react with :raising_hand: if you want to facilitate an exercise.
